pick.headline: Ceausescu leaves on a visit to Iran amid the Timisoara crisis
pick.summary: On December 18, 1989, Nicolae Ceausescu left Bucharest for a state visit to Iran, while his security forces were putting down the uprising in Timisoara.
pick.significance: He cut the visit short and returned on December 20 to a regime days from collapse.

alternates.headline: Kim Young-sam elected president of South Korea
alternates.summary: On December 18, 1992, Kim Young-sam won South Korea's presidential election, becoming its first civilian president in three decades.
alternates.significance: His government curbed the military and the intelligence service and prosecuted former presidents Chun and Roh.
